This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 18.04.2026 (the "Effective Date") by and
between Müller Industrietechnik GmbH, with its registered office at Hauptstraße 42, Hamburg ("Party A"), and Müller
Industrietechnik GmbH, with its registered office at Berliner Allee 19, Stuttgart ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 36 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in
accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the
purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.
